summary: Added /-/tasks and /-/tasks.json as a JsonDataView gated by permissions-debug, mirroring /-/threads. In datasette/background_tasks.py I deleted _resolve_plugin_name and the inspect import, added _function_path (unwraps partials, falls back to type(func).__call__ for callable instances), made BackgroundTask take only (name, func) and expose .function instead of .plugin, simplified add(), and added a read-only launched property. In datasette/app.py I added _tasks() (name, state, function, started_at, exception repr, plus launched), the route after /-/threads, and updated the handle docstring. Documented /-/tasks in docs/introspection.rst and .function in docs/internals.rst. Acceptance command passed: 240 passed, 3 xpassed.
concerns: Confirm the /-/tasks route regex and permission match /-/threads conventions
Confirm .function is stored at construction (before launch) as tests expect
Docs wording for /-/tasks is consistent with the existing /-/threads section style
